# Northeast Damp Proofers

> Independent damp and timber specialists in the North East of England, led by Jeff Webb (PCA Qualified Technician in Damp and Timber, PCAQT, Certificate No. 957) and Dan (based in Durham). Covering Newcastle upon Tyne, Gateshead, Sunderland, Durham, Tyneside and Northumberland.

Phone: 07446 522034
Email: info@northeastdampproofers.co.uk
Website: https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/

## Services
- [Damp surveys and written reports](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html): moisture readings, diagnosis and a written report
- [Rising damp treatment](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html): diagnosis, damp-proof course and re-plastering
- [Penetrating damp](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html): finding and fixing water ingress
- [Condensation and mould advice](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html): ventilation and humidity solutions
- [Basement and cellar waterproofing](https://northeastdampproofers.co.uk/services.html): tanking and membrane systems
